newsitem.title: GERMANY: Conti aims to reach 2.5 pct return on sales.
newsitem.headline: Conti aims to reach 2.5 pct return on sales.

text.p: German tyre manufacturer Continental AG said on Wednesday that it planned to reach a sustainable net return on sales of at least 2.5 percent.
Once this was secured, the company's goal would be even more profitable, management board chairman Hubertus von Gruenberg said at the group's annual meeting in Hannover.
Net return on sales after tax was 1.5 percent in 1995 and 1.9 percent in 1996.
Earlier, Conti said it expected a significant rise in net profit in full-year 1997 and that sales would rise about five percent to 11 billion marks.
The group said pre-tax profits in the first five months of 1997 rose 47 percent to 185 million marks, while sales rose 2.3 percent to 4.4 billion marks in the same period.
